fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant reported that a white truck bearing registration number TN-39-ZZ-1059 parked near Roja Layout Industrial Area in Thanjavur could not be found the next morning. The matter was brought to Thanjavur Town PS on 2025-04-03, while the incident was placed on 2025-04-03 around 23:25 hrs. Contact details given by the complainant, Abirami Sekar, include the number 9000000186. The complainant alleged that Gokul Muthu may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000234. Madhan Kumar (9000000410) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Items referenced in the complaint: a vehicle observation and CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00034, as the mobile number 9000000234 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly driven away from an industrial parking space at night.
fields.Keywords: truck theft, vehicle, night, industrial area, mobile number, CCTV, truck, vehicle observation
